notes.title: Update: Version 1.07 Controller Support / Summer Sale Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.
We have added support for controllers, which we announced at the time of release as one of our future plans.
In addition, we are offering a 15% discount on MASAGORO during summer sale.

[h1]Added Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Controller support
[/list] 
The game now supports controller operation.
For more information about the control keys, please refer to the "How to operate" section in the game.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bathroom door to disappear under certain circumstances.
[/list]

notes.title: Several fatal bugs have been fixed.(2021/03/27)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.
The following bugs have been fixed today.
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the map would keep appearing if you pressed the Q button while the item screen was displayed after picking up an item.
[*] Fixed a problem where the sound of breathing would be lost when restarting after a game over.
[*] Fixed some typos in the text.
[/list]
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
We will continue to fix fatal bugs as soon as they are found.

notes.title: MASAGORO has been released!
notes.notes:
[h1]We have released MASAGORO today![/h1]
As a launch discount, you can purchase MASAGORO at 15% off the regular price for 7 days from today.

[h2]Notice regarding playing environment[/h2]
We recommend that you play MASAGORO with stereo headphones and spatial sound enabled.

[h3]Enabling Spatial Sound[/h3]
If you are using Windows 10, you can use spatial sound by following the steps below to enable Windows Sonic.
[url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/how-to-turn-on-spatial-sound-in-windows-10-ca2700a0-6519-448d-5434-56f499d59c96]How to turn on spatial sound in Windows 10[/url].
You can also enable it by right-clicking on the speaker icon in the Windows taskbar and selecting Spatial Sound.

In addition to Windows Sonic, you can also use spatial sound with Dolby Atmos or DTS Sound Unbound. (You will need to purchase the app to use it.)

[h2]Plans for future support[/h2]
We are planning to support controller operation in the near future.
If any problems are found, we plan to fix them as soon as possible.

[h2]Release Commemorative Content[/h2]
Digital contents will be distributed to commemorate the release of MASAGORO.
You can download it from the MASAGORO official website below.
https://dorsalfingamestudio.wixsite.com/masagoro/art?lang=en

notes.title: MASAGORO has gone gold!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the game is now ready for the release of MASAGORO on March 26th.
The game will be available for download from 6:00 PDT on that day.

We are planning to distribute digital contents at the time of the release of MASAGORO.

Brochure of MASAGORO Ryokan
This will be image data that can be printed out and used as an actual pamphlet.

Digital artwork of MASAGORO
This is the artwork that was prepared to create the assets for the MASAGORO game.
This is an image data distribution only.

We plan to distribute these digital contents to everyone, regardless of whether they own the game or not.
